Ⓑ

Ⓑ

Ⓝ[Specif]ically,Ⓒadv.ⒹjAtitaH, viSezataH, saviSezaM.

Ⓝ[Specif]ied,Ⓒa.Ⓓnirdizwa, avacCinna, nirdizwa-ukta-lakzaRa &c.; ‘will be s(pecified) further on’ agre vakzyate.
Ⓝ[Specif]ication,Ⓒs.ⒹviSezanirdeSaH-kaTanaM-varRanaM, vyavacCedaH, parisaMKyA, viSezaH.
